## Pramana
Pramana is a DPDP governance product from Annapurna, focused on digital personal-data processing across business and technology workflows. AI is one use case within the wider DPDP context. Public product information is intentionally high level; implementation, integration, security and commercial details are not published here.

Public Pramana pages provide general information and educational prompts. They do not assess an organisation’s legal applicability, calculate readiness or penalties, issue a compliance certificate, or replace qualified legal advice.

## Trust policy
Marketing claims should be checked against the Evidence page. Repository activity is engineering evidence, not proof of adoption or production maturity. Public-source conflicts remain visible rather than being silently reconciled toward a promotional interpretation.

## DPDP official-source policy
Regulatory summaries should be checked against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, official commencement notifications, the final Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 and official corrigenda. The Act and Rules have phased commencement. Check provision-level status as of the date being assessed; notification of an instrument does not mean every substantive obligation is already operative.

- DPDP Act, 2023: https://www.meity.gov.in/static/uploads/2024/02/Digital-Personal-Data-Protection-Act-2023.pdf
- G.S.R. 843(E), commencement notification: https://www.meity.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/11/c56ceae6c383460ca69577428d36828b.pdf
- DPDP Rules, 2025 / G.S.R. 846(E): https://www.meity.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/11/53450e6e5dc0bfa85ebd78686cadad39.pdf
- MeitY Rules and corrigendum listing: https://www.meity.gov.in/documents/act-and-policies/digital-personal-data-protection-rules-2025-gDOxUjMtQWa?pageTitle=Digital-Personal-Data-Protection-Rules-2025

This information is general and is not a legal opinion, applicability assessment or compliance determination.
